headline: Bitcoin hovers near $65,000 after Monday's tech-led sell-off, with Nvidia's results due tonight US time and a December Fed rate rise almost fully priced in.

stories.title: Bitcoin stuck near $65,000 as markets wait for Nvidia's results tonight
stories.summary: Bitcoin traded around $65,000 in Asian hours after Monday's tech-led sell-off on Wall Street. Nvidia, the AI chip maker, reports results after the US close today, its first report since its CEO Jensen Huang resigned.
points: Bitcoin was at $64,959 at around 04:40 UTC, with a 24-hour range of $63,879 to $65,502, per CryptoTicker.
Asian stocks fell: Japan's Nikkei -1.2%, South Korea's Kospi -1.1% and Hong Kong's Hang Seng -1.3%, per Digital Journal.
Nvidia's results come about 4:20pm ET (about 04:20 Wed Bangkok) with the call at 5pm ET. Revenue forecasts: $108.84B per MarketPulse, $108.7B per Seeking Alpha; earnings $2.47 a share.
Huang resigned on 12 November and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, per Nvidia's filing with the SEC.

stories.title: Traders now price a December Fed rate rise as near-certain; US retail sales and Fed's Waller today
stories.summary: Futures markets now bet the Fed will raise interest rates on 9 December, and some bets are on a bigger half-point move. The 10-year US Treasury yield is above 5%. Higher rates make assets that pay no interest, like bitcoin, less attractive. Today's US retail sales and a speech by Fed Governor Waller are the next clues.
points: CME FedWatch showed about a 90.7% chance of a 0.25-point rise and about 9.3% for a 0.5-point rise on 9 December, per CryptoTicker. That is a market bet, not a Fed decision.
The 10-year Treasury yield was 5.116% on Monday morning, up from 4.83% a week earlier, per CoinDesk.
On prediction market Kalshi, a 0.25-point rise was at 89%, per CoinGabbar.
US retail sales for October come at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok): consensus +0.2%, prior +0.8%, per Finviz. Waller speaks at 9:10am ET (21:10 Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve.
Minutes of the October Fed meeting come out Wednesday at 2pm ET (02:00 Thursday Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve.

stories.title: CFTC in focus: Senate hearing for two nominees today, and Democrats push back on its prediction-market order
stories.summary: The CFTC, the US regulator for futures and derivatives, including much of crypto trading, has only one sitting commissioner. The Senate Agriculture Committee holds a hearing today on two nominees to join it. Separately, Democratic senators asked the CFTC to reverse an order on prediction markets such as Kalshi.
points: The hearing on nominees Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland is listed for 3:00pm ET (03:00 Wednesday Bangkok), per the Senate Agriculture Committee.
Chair Michael Selig is the CFTC's only sitting commissioner, per KuCoin News.

Democrats on the committee want the CFTC to reverse its order that platforms like Kalshi stop blocking users in some states within 30 days; they say it conflicts with court orders in several states, per Cryptonews.
The CFTC has also approved blockchain-based derivatives exchanges run by Backpack (announced Monday) and tZERO (the week before), per The Block.

briefs.title: Judge acquits MEV bot brothers
briefs.summary: A US judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno of wire fraud and related charges over a $25M Ethereum trading-bot exploit in April 2023, per The Block.

briefs.title: Zelle picks Solana for its stablecoin
briefs.summary: Early Warning, the bank-owned company behind Zelle, will issue its ZelleUSD stablecoin on Solana with Anchorage Digital Bank as issuer, starting with payments to India, per BigGo Finance.

briefs.title: Wells Fargo doubles reported bitcoin ETF holding
briefs.summary: Wells Fargo reported 49.58M shares of BlackRock's bitcoin ETF (IBIT), worth about $2.35B on 30 September, up from 24.4M shares at the end of June, per CoinDesk. The figure may include client holdings.

briefs.title: Strategy keeps buying
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 485 BTC at an average $68,887, taking it to 850,849 BTC at an average cost of $75,452, above the current price, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Lighter resumes withdrawals
briefs.summary: Lighter recovered about $5M in USDC and turned withdrawals back on after an exploit, per Crypto Economy.

briefs.title: $6.45M taken from a Safe wallet
briefs.summary: About $6.45M left a Safe multisig wallet through a third-party add-on after a probable key compromise; Safe says its own contracts and app were not affected, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty
briefs.summary: A former Robinhood engineer pleaded guilty to wire fraud for using confidential listing plans to trade on Hyperliquid, and agreed to forfeit $125,523, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Supreme Court turns away Custodia Bank
briefs.summary: The Supreme Court declined to hear crypto bank Custodia's case, leaving in place a ruling that Fed banks can refuse it a master account, per Bitcoin Magazine.
